title: diaspora through 0.10.1, using the diaspora_federation gem through 1.2.0, contains a server-side request forgery…
description: Diaspora versions through 0.10.1, using the diaspora_federation gem through 1.2.0, have a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to cause the pod to send HTTP requests to arbitrary internal hosts by crafting a diaspora handle that triggers WebFinger discovery without filtering private addresses. Attackers can specify handles with IPv4/IPv6 addresses and ports, enabling blind probing of internal networks including loopback, RFC1918, link-local, or cloud metadata addresses.
